import pandas as pd

# Read source CSV files with index_col=0 to ignore the numerical index column
source_files_0_to_8 = [
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length9_86/training_0.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length9_86/training_1.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length9_86/training_2.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length9_86/training_3.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length9_86/training_4.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length9_86/training_5.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length9_86/training_6.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length9_86/training_7.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length9_86/training_8.csv",
]

# Load and concatenate sources 0 to 8 (UNION)
dfs_0_to_8 = [pd.read_csv(f, index_col=0) for f in source_files_0_to_8]
union_0_to_8 = pd.concat(dfs_0_to_8, ignore_index=True)

# Read source 9
source_9_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length9_86/training_9.csv"
df_9 = pd.read_csv(source_9_path, index_col=0)

# Perform JOIN on ['admit', 'gre', 'gpa', 'prestige'] between source 9 and union of sources 0 to 8
# This is an inner join on all columns (admit, gre, gpa, prestige)
target_df = pd.merge(
    df_9,
    union_0_to_8,
    on=["admit", "gre", "gpa", "prestige"],
    how="inner",
    suffixes=("", "_y"),
)

# After join, keep only the columns of the target schema: ['admit', 'gre', 'gpa', 'prestige']
# The join may add duplicate columns with suffix '_y', drop them if any
target_df = target_df[["admit", "gre", "gpa", "prestige"]]

# Ensure correct dtypes as per target schema
target_df = target_df.astype({
    "admit": "int64",
    "gre": "int64",
    "gpa": "float64",
    "prestige": "int64"
})

# Write the final target table to the specified path without the index
target_df.to_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_86/target_multisource.csv", index=False)
